title: Forest of the Skeleton Queen
physical_identity: Infinite ever-dark forest under a crescent moon and starless sky; skeletons hang from trees and clatter in the wind.
scale_topology: Infinite; outdoor forest; no vertical structure stated.
anomalies: no exit until meeting the Queen
lighting_sound: Moonlight only; skeletons clatter, wind whistles through skulls; hearsay of speech.

entities.name: The Belle
entities.behavior: silent woman in orange Victorian dress who lures wanderers

entities.name: The Skeleton Queen
entities.behavior: commands trees and ground; may release respectful wanderers

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: The Belle, The Skeleton Queen
hazards: being trapped before meeting the Queen

entrances.method: Get lost in a dark forest
entrances.quote: all it takes to enter is getting lost in a dark forest
arrived in the level directly from the Frontrooms

exits.method: Released by the Skeleton Queen; wake in another forest
exits.quote: find themselves waking up in another forest of the Backrooms

signature_mechanic: Follow the Belle to the Skeleton Queen; the encounter is the only exit and her judgement of respect decides release or death.
conflicts_notes: Page flagged outdated; survival class not filled; vignette is fiction/testimony, not general rule.

only a single entity roams the level; one being in two forms
